articles.title: Rosalind Sandoval, 93, Bus Driver
articles.deck: Friends remember Rosalind Sandoval for the many years of service to Canal Park.
body: Rosalind Sandoval died in January at home on Canal Street, at the age of 93.

Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foundry Row Mutual Aid Group in his or her name. Born in Canal Park in the years after the war, Rosalind Sandoval spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Canal Park.

articles.title: Letter: The Stormwater Drain Repair on Fairview Road Needs Attention
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the December meeting.
Please keep the stormwater drain repair in the budget. Many of us on Fairview Road use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
Lamar Kim, Cedar Hollow

articles.title: Then & Now: the Hickory Ridge Rec Center, 1985 and 2017
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1985 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Union Lane from the corner of Carver Place.

Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal. Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height.
